questions.text: Two stations S1 and S2 are 766 km apart. One train starts from S1 at 5:20 a.m. and travels towards S2 at 74 kmph. Another train starts from S2 at 7:50 a.m. and travels towards S1 on parallel tracks at a speed of 92 kmph. At what time will they meet?
